primaryTextRead.text: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.
The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

wikipediaRead.locator: L–Z shared list, lines 466–470, heading Meshelemiah. It says Korhite Levite, also called Shelemiah, and cites 1CH9:21 and 26:1–14.

wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: 9:21 and 26:1–9 directly name Meshelemiah; 26:14 uses Shelemiah and is retained as an article-supported related spelling, not silently normalized.
